_about: Router and benchmark settings. 'cost' means estimated subscription allowance. Dispatch uses configured priors. The advisory bench route uses measured cost for deployments with learned_cost_min_n priced attempts.
_data_mode: All modes run the full four-deployment blind batch on every first task dispatch. Mode affects extra cross-checks, not production tier defaults or that batch.
_cross_checks: Extra checkers for benchmark data. check_down_rate: chance that a result checked by terra (or sol) is also checked by luna (or terra). check_up_rate: chance of a check one model up (sol over terra; astra over sol, only on P1-P2 work). astra_down_probe: sol re-checks astra's checks on headline (V4) claims, on all P1 ('p1'), or never. Disagreements: luna vs terra -> luna counted wrong, luna_audit_rate of them re-judged by sol; terra vs sol -> astra adjudicates; sol vs astra -> both reconsider with the other's report. max_adjudications per project caps the extra cost.
_concurrency: Main slots, separate from probe slots. These are ceilings, not targets: dispatch ready independent work within the run budget. Provider rate limits and local compute limits still apply.
